mapper.select: SELECT w.WISH_ID AS wishId, w.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, w.USER_ID AS userId, w.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRICE AS price, i.IMG_URL AS imgUrl FROM WISHLIST w INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON w.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE w.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY w.CREATED_AT DESC, w.WISH_ID DESC
